ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white (approx. 85%) vs low-intensity black (approx. 15%); sharp bimodal distribution with minimal grayscale transitions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity boundary along the trailing edge and terminal tips. Multiple discrete circular low-intensity blobs (approx. 10-15 units) scattered medially. Large irregular low-intensity mass at the left and right distal extremities.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression; interior pixel angle approximately 60 degrees; depth ratio of approx 1:6 relative to fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, non-uniform serration map; approx. 28 distinct peaks; peak-to-valley amplitude varies between 8 and 22 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral symmetry with convex outer margins (positive curvature) transitioning to concave curves (negative curvature) as the boundary approaches the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular pixel clusters (low intensity on high intensity) detected: one primary cluster on left medial lobe, several smaller clusters distributed across the right medial lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of 5 parallel linear low-intensity disruptions (rake marks) on the lower-right lobe region; 1 isolated linear scar on the lower-left lobe region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent odontocete-style rake marks on the right ventral lobe; various circular scarring consistent with historical barnacle attachment sites.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct crescent-shaped black mark on the left-center lobe and a feathered serration pattern on the far right distal edge.
